abilities.name: Underway Ear
abilities.text: Deepdale hears pressure changes in sealed routes before the lamps begin to flicker.

abilities.name: Black Dust Craft
abilities.text: Broken shops, caches, and salvage yards give him enough material to make one more repair matter.

abilities.name: Lantern Delver
abilities.text: Anomaly-lit paths are less frightening when Deepdale has already counted the echoes.

abilities.name: Deep Bargain
abilities.text: When a market demands risk, he knows which debt can be paid now and which one can wait.
